title: The mystery of 1729
description:
A taxi number. A hospital visit. And one of the most fascinating stories in mathematics. 🧠

When G. H. Hardy mentioned the number 1729 to Srinivasa Ramanujan, he had no idea how special it was.

Two different combinations of cubes. The exact same answer.

Some people see ordinary numbers. Others see mathematical magic.

Would you have spotted the secret behind 1729?
